mapper.select: # SELECT * # FROM fx_orders_info # where order_status = 5 # and (supplier_id in # (select label from system_dict_data where dict_type = 'fx_business_entity' and color_type = 'info') # or # receive_supplier_id in # (select label from system_dict_data where dict_type = 'fx_business_entity' and color_type = 'info') # ) WITH supplier_filter AS (SELECT label FROM system_dict_data WHERE dict_type = 'fx_business_entity' AND color_type = 'info') SELECT * FROM fx_orders_info WHERE order_status = 5 AND ( supplier_id IN (SELECT label FROM supplier_filter) OR receive_supplier_id IN (SELECT label FROM supplier_filter) )
mapper.update: UPDATE fx_orders_info t SET t.order_type = CASE WHEN LOCATE('一件代发单', t.remark) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN LOCATE('客商代发单', t.remark) > 0 THEN 2 WHEN LOCATE('销售退货单', t.remark) > 0 THEN 4 WHEN LOCATE('爱库存', t.remark) > 0 OR LOCATE('快团团', t.remark) > 0 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END, t.brand = (SELECT b.brand FROM fx_orders_detail a JOIN fx_goods_archives b ON a.sku_id = b.id WHERE a.order_id = t.id ORDER BY b.brand DESC LIMIT 1), t.order_status = 10 WHERE t.id = #{vId}
